intro: The difference between inventing and discovering, and how to tell the story of a finding.
p.ciencia.consejo: The «c» before «i» sounds like «th»: «THYEN-thya». It is feminine: «la ciencia».
p.científico.consejo: For a woman: «la científica». It has an accent on the í: «thyen-TI-fi-ko».
p.investigar.consejo: The «v» sounds like b: «in-bes-ti-GAR». A police case is also «investigado».
p.experimento.consejo: The x sounds like «ks»: «eks-pe-ri-MEN-to». It is done to check an idea.
p.laboratorio.consejo: It ends in «-torio», like «territorio». The stress is on «to»: «la-bo-ra-TO-ryo».
p.inventar.consejo: You invent something new; you discover something that was already there. You can also invent a story.
p.invento.consejo: It comes from «inventar». «Un invento» did not exist before.
p.descubrimiento.consejo: It comes from «descubrir». «Un descubrimiento» was already there, but nobody knew.
p.demostrar.consejo: The o changes to ue: «demuestro, demuestras». In «demostramos» it does not change.
p.resultado.consejo: It comes from «resultar». An experiment gives a «resultado».
p.avance.consejo: It comes from «avanzar». A scientific «avance» improves the lives of many.
p.por casualidad.consejo: The opposite is «a propósito»: something done on purpose.
b1.texto:
**Ciencia** moves forward with research: a **científico** does an **experimento** in the **laboratorio** and gets a **resultado**.

- **Inventar** is to create something new: an **invento**.
- **Descubrir** is to find something that already existed: a **descubrimiento**.
- **Demostrar** is to prove that something is true.

Sometimes a great **avance** comes **por casualidad**. To tell the story of a discovery we use the past and the passive: **fue descubierta**, **se descubrió**, **se han salvado**.
b2.f0.texto: Yesterday I saw a documentary about penicillin.
b2.f2.texto: Alexander Fleming discovered it in his laboratory.
b2.f5.texto: Then Fleming did not invent anything.
b2.f6.texto: An invention did not exist before.
b4.titulo: The passive: fue descubierta, se descubrió
b4.texto:
To tell what was discovered and not who did it, use the passive:

- **ser** + participle: **la penicilina fue descubierta en 1928**. The participle agrees with the subject (descubierta, descubierto, descubiertos).
- **se** + verb: **se descubrió la penicilina**; **se han salvado millones de vidas**. It is the most common form in speech.

The participle of **descubrir** is irregular: **descubierto**.
b4.e1.texto: This antibiotic was discovered by chance.
b4.e2.texto: Millions of lives have been saved.
b5.f0.texto: In 1928, a laboratory in London smells of dust, wood and cold glass.
b5.f1.texto: On the table rest rows of plates with bacteria.
b5.f2.texto: Alexander Fleming switches off the lamp and leaves on holiday.
b5.f3.texto: For days, the sunlight comes in through the window and warms the still air.
b5.f4.texto: On a forgotten plate a soft green stain slowly grows.
b5.f5.texto: On returning, Fleming looks at the plates with tired eyes.
b5.f6.texto: Around the green stain, the bacteria have disappeared.
b5.f7.texto: A small fungus has killed them without a sound.
b5.f8.texto: The scientist keeps quiet for a moment and smiles.
b5.f9.texto: This is how penicillin, the first antibiotic, is born, thanks to a chance event.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That's it! An «invento» is something created, new.
b6.o1.refuerzo: A «descubrimiento» already existed; it was just found.
b6.o2.refuerzo: A «resultado» is what comes out of a test.
b6.pregunta: Something that did not exist before is…
b7.o0.refuerzo: After «han» you need a participle, not the infinitive.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That form does not exist: it is an irregular participle.
b7.pregunta: It is an irregular participle. Which form is missing?
b8.traduccion: That is how penicillin was discovered
b9.o0.refuerzo: It is the opposite: «a propósito» is on purpose.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Care has nothing to do with chance.
b10.o0.refuerzo: To invent is to create something new, not to prove a fact.
b10.o1.refuerzo: To research is to study; here there is already proof.
b10.o2.refuerzo: That's it! «Demostrar» is to prove that something is true.
b10.pregunta: Someone has proof that it works. What is missing?
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Descubrida» does not exist: the participle is «descubierta».
b12.o1.refuerzo: After «fue» comes a participle, not the infinitive.
b12.pregunta: Which sentence tells the discovery correctly?
p.documental.consejo: The stress is on the last syllable: «do-ku-men-TAL». The «c» before «u» sounds like k.
p.penicilina.consejo: The «c» before «i» sounds like «th»: «pe-ni-thi-LI-na». Only one «l» in Spanish.
p.descubrió.consejo: Past of «descubrir». The accent on the «ó» marks the stress: «des-ku-BRYO», one syllable «BRYO».
p.inventó.consejo: Past of «inventar». It has an accent on the «ó» and the stress falls on it: «in-ben-TO». The «v» sounds like b.
p.existía.consejo: Imperfect of «existir». The accent on the «í» separates «i» and «a»: «ek-sis-TI-a». The «x» sounds «ks».
p.naturaleza.consejo: The «z» sounds like «th»: «na-tu-ra-LE-tha». It is feminine: «la naturaleza».
p.ahí.consejo: It has an accent on the «í»: «a-I». The «h» is silent. «Ahí» is near you; «allí» is farther.
p.descubierta.consejo: Irregular participle of «descubrir», feminine: «descubierto, descubierta». It agrees with «penicilina».
p.antibiótico.consejo: It has an accent on the «ó»: «an-ti-BYO-ti-ko». The prefix «anti-» means against.
p.salvado.consejo: Participle of «salvar»: «se han salvado vidas». The «v» sounds like b: «sal-BA-do».
p.polvo.consejo: The «v» sounds like b: «POL-bo». It is masculine: «el polvo».
p.filas.consejo: Plural of «fila». «Hacer fila» is to stand in line. It is feminine: «las filas».
p.placas.consejo: Plural of «placa». The «c» before «a» sounds like k: «PLA-kas». In a lab it is a dish for bacteria.
p.bacterias.consejo: Plural of «bacteria». The «c» before «t» sounds like k: «bak-TE-ryas». It is feminine: «las bacterias».
p.quieto.consejo: The «qu» sounds like k and the «u» is silent: «KYE-to». The «ie» is one syllable.
p.placa.consejo: Singular of «placas». The «c» before «a» sounds like k: «PLA-ka». It is feminine: «la placa».
p.olvidada.consejo: Feminine of «olvidado». It agrees with «placa». The «v» sounds like b.
p.crece.consejo: From «crecer». The «c» before «e» sounds like «th»: «KRE-the». In «crezco» it becomes «zc».
p.mancha.consejo: The «ch» sounds like in «chocolate»: «MAN-cha». It is feminine: «la mancha».
p.volver.consejo: Both «v» sound like b: «bol-BER». The «o» changes to «ue» when stressed: «vuelvo».
p.desaparecido.consejo: Participle of «desaparecer»: «han desaparecido». The «c» before «i» sounds like «th».
p.hongo.consejo: The «h» is silent: «ON-go». The «g» before «o» is hard.
p.nace.consejo: From «nacer». The «c» before «e» sounds like «th»: «NA-the». It can be said of people and of ideas.
p.casualidad.consejo: It ends in «-dad». The «u» and «a» form one syllable: «ka-swa-li-DAD». It is feminine: «la casualidad».
p.descubierto.consejo: Irregular participle of «descubrir»: «ha descubierto». It is not «descubrido».
p.buscarlo.consejo: The pronoun «lo» joins the infinitive: «buscar» + «lo» = «buscarlo». «Sin buscarlo» is without looking for it.
p.demostrado.consejo: Participle of «demostrar»: «se ha demostrado». It is regular, and the «o» stays «o».
